description: Create a new device posture integration.

clientId.description: Client ID for the provider (Intune: application UUID; Falcon/Jamf Pro: client id; Kandji/Kolide/Sentinel One: leave blank). Fleet and Huntress: Tailscale does not document how their credentials map onto these API fields -- the admin console asks for a Fleet URL + API token (Fleet) and an API key + API secret, plus an optional organization ID (Huntress). Do not assume this can be left blank; confirm the mapping first.

clientSecret.description: The secret (auth key, token, etc.) used to authenticate with the provider. SENSITIVE: passed straight to Tailscale and not echoed back, but MCP clients may log the input value you supply.

cloudId.description: Identifies which of the provider's clouds to integrate with. Falcon: us-1|us-2|eu-1|us-gov; Intune: global|us-gov; Jamf Pro/Kandji/Sentinel One: FQDN of your subdomain; Kolide: leave blank. Fleet/Huntress: undocumented upstream (see clientId).

provider.description: The posture provider slug: falcon (CrowdStrike Falcon), fleet, huntress, intune (Microsoft Intune), jamfpro (Jamf Pro), kandji (Iru, formerly Kandji), kolide (1Password XAM, formerly Kolide), sentinelone

tenantId.description: Microsoft Intune directory (tenant) ID. Other providers leave blank. Fleet/Huntress: undocumented upstream (see clientId).
